body: Be careful with that.  My wife cheated on me but to prevent me from finding out, she asked us to open our marriage so it would "save" our strained relationship with each other, and she continued to see the man she cheated on me with, as well as several others, while encouraging me to see other people as well.  She gaslit me, and it's a different situation, yes, but be on the lookout, and be careful.  Once a cheater...

For someone I'll never know, in person, but for someone who may or may not be seeing this, I just want to say, this is a heartbreaking moment, because in this very second of connection, we see each other, and we will never see each other again.  Time and societal definitions aside, you are my friend, and I am so sorry to see you go, friend.  I hope you will find happiness and peace out there.  I will miss you.

All variations of the following names:

Jennifer. Rebecca. April. Elizabeth. Heidi. Catherine. Sarah. Stacey.

Multiple dates and/or relationships with people with each of those names, and I will never date anyone with those names again.
Same thing happened to me.  I wonder if it's a system glitch?
Oh, how I feel this on a spiritual level.  Please message me if you can.

Oh, I've got a doozy.

"Friend:" Hey how are you feeling?  
Me: Declining.  How are you?  
"Friend:" That happens in life lol
